templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from overview-with-inset by the note-writer: a plain three-stage pipeline (its own corpus label) with small decorative rate-over-time sparkline icons beside the inputs, not a magnified sub-block of any drawn component.
templates.what_to_learn: The transferable move is pipeline's: give each of several parallel input streams its own tiny characterizing chart, and distinguish repeated content (four differently-shaped models packed in one worker's GPU memory) by both shape and colour, then legend the shapes explicitly, since this exemplar leaves them unexplained.
